title: Ki njëkka sàkku jéggalu
intro: Dellu ci jamono balaa jant bi di fenk, balaa nit ku nekk di dox ci kaw suuf. Ñu defar jëmm ci mbir yu woyof, ñu jox ko barab bu gëna kawe malaaka yi, ñu def ko ci jardin bu sell, ñu teg ko ci artu bu leer. Waaye ci saasi, ñu def tànneef bu nara am ci taarixu doomi aadama yi yépp. Kan mooy lim bii?
clues: Dañu ma sàkk ci anam wu wuute ak yeneen yi — ñu defaree ma ci pëndu suuf, ba noppi jox ma ruuh buy dundu ci loxo Boroom bi.
Dañu ma jox xam-xam bu xóot ba sax malaaka yi ci kaw yéemu ci.
Ñu sant asamaan yépp ñu sukku ci sama kanam, ñu déggal leen ñépp, lu moy kenn ki bañ ndax réy-réy.
Ñu dugal ma ci jardin bu sell, di barab bu may féexal xol ba fàww, waaye amna luñu ma tere woon.
Ma fàtte, ma réer, ba noppi ma déggal — ma yëg diisaayu sama njuumte bu baax.
Ma jublu sama Boroom ci ay kàddu yu wér xol, mu nangul ma sama tuub, ndax Mooy Aji Baale ji.

trial.label: Jàngat/Xew-xew
options: Malaaka yi dañu leen digal ñu sujjóot .

trial.answer: Malaaka yi dañu leen digal ñu sujjóot .

outcome.label: Njureef
options: Réew mi dafa mujjee am mbëkk bu am doole

arabic: فَتَلَقَّىٰٓ ءَادَمُ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ كَلِمَـٰتٍۢ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verse: Then Adam received from his Lord [some] words, and He accepted his repentance. Indeed, it is He who is the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful. (2:37)
